_comment: Remote desktop, hub-tier: the cache fetches the pinned release asset and the agent installs it. Upstream publishes no checksums, so every sha256 here is the hub's own, taken once from the 1.4.9 assets. Flutter builds only — the *-sciter assets carry a proprietary engine the AGPL does not admit. AGPL-3.0 obliges directions to the source beside the binary: corresponding_source names the exact tag, and every row renders it.
name: rustdesk
title: RustDesk
description: Remote desktop, direct connect on the LAN; the Remote desktop service needs it

linux-rhel-amd64.uninstall: if command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then dnf remove -y rustdesk; else yum remove -y rustdesk; fi

windows-amd64.uninstall: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$k = Get-ChildItem HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -like '{*}' -and (Get-ItemProperty $_.PSPath).DisplayName -eq 'RustDesk' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $k) { exit 0 }; exit (Start-Process msiexec -Wait -PassThru -ArgumentList '/x', $k.PSChildName, '/quiet', '/norestart').ExitCode"

windows-arm64.uninstall: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$k = Get-ChildItem HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -like '{*}' -and (Get-ItemProperty $_.PSPath).DisplayName -eq 'RustDesk' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $k) { exit 0 }; exit (Start-Process msiexec -Wait -PassThru -ArgumentList '/x', $k.PSChildName, '/quiet', '/norestart').ExitCode"
